name: Old-Age Pension Scheme
benefit: ₹ 850/- per month to pensioners aged between 60 years to 69 years.₹ 1500/- per month to pensioners aged 70 years and above.
eligibility_rules: The applicants must be a resident of Himachal Pradesh state. Such elderly persons whose age is 60 years or more and who do not have proper means of care/upbringing and who have minor children and whose family annual income from all sources does not exceed ₹ 35,000/- Or;Such elderly persons whose annual family income from all sources does not exceed ₹ 35000/- are eligible for the scheme.
documents_required: Following are the documents required to apply for the
Scheme: Passport Size Photographs Age proof Income Certificate Aadhaar CardBank Account/passbook copyAny other documents as
how_to_apply: Mode: OfflineStep 1: Download the Social Security Pension Application Form.Step 2: Fill in all the mandatory fields, paste the recent passport-sized photograph (signed across), and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attested).Step 3: Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents to the concerned authority at: Office of Panchayat Tehsil Welfare Officer District Welfare Officer.
